description: Reads complete saved node details with version and nodeIds, or bounded live facts with query. The two forms are mutually exclusive. Read the returned details array directly.

pageId.description: The page that owns the saved observation.

version.description: The saved observation version to read; this does not refresh live state.

items.description: An opaque node ID from the current observation. Do not parse it.
